content:
Amazon has dropped a new batch of LEGO deals for its Black Friday sale, and one particularly cozy Nintendo franchise is getting plenty of discount love.

Pretty much every LEGO Animal Crossing set is currently on sale, including the retired sets that are no longer available directly through LEGO. The discount quality varies, but the biggest discounts happen to be on what I consider the best sets in the theme, getting you solid Animal Crossing buildings and some cute villager minifigures.

LEGO Animal Crossing Sets Get Big Discounts for Black Friday

The LEGO Animal Crossing theme offers something for every generation. The sets generally feature an assortment of smaller builds inspired by specific elements from New Horizons. You control how exactly the pieces of your plastic brick island fit together, offering plenty of opportunity for both display and play.

The biggest discount also lasts the shortest amount of time. The Creative Houses: Seasons of Fun set has dropped by over 50%, bringing it well below its previous lowest price on record. However, the discount only lasts until midnight. The rest of the deals will likely last through Black Friday proper, or as long as stock lasts.

The Creative Houses set is one of quite a few Animal Crossing sets LEGO has already retired, which is why Amazon can give it such a big discount. The set gives you two villager house variations, a small tree you can swap between seasons, and a batch of villager minifigures: Fang, Fuschia, and Stitches.

Two more sets getting big Black Friday discounts are Blather’s Museum ( down to $47.99 ) and the joint Nook’s Cranny and Rosie’s House set ( down to $51.99 ). Blather’s Museum is the most ‘traditional’ build of the bunch, but like most sets in the theme, still comes with plenty of easter eggs.

We’re also seeing the latest release in the Animal Crossing theme hit its lowest price yet. I got the chance to build the LEGO Timmy and Tommy set myself, and now treat the twin tanuki like my trusty desk companions.

While most of the theme offers classic characters in the form of minifigures, this particular set has you building pretty sizable versions of Tom Nook’s assistants. Animal Crossing generally translates very well into plastic brick form.

The other sets on sale are dedicated to specific villagers like Goldie. Some of these smaller deals are actually Amazon price-matching other retailers like Target and LEGO itself, so they don't get the "Black Friday" label like the rest of Amazon’s discounts.

We’re Keeping Track of All the LEGO Black Friday Deals

Black Friday might not actually be until next week, but pretty much every retailer has already launched their official sale, and we don’t expect any existing discounts to go much lower. If you’re looking for more sets, check out the best LEGO deals we’ve found so far or the LEGO Store’s full sale schedule.

We’re also keeping track of everything going on at Nintendo, which happens to be the only company dropping a console deal.
